result:
All tests pass. Here's a summary of the changes made:

---

**`src/click/exceptions.py`** — `BadParameter` gains an `env_var: str | None` field (default `None`). `format_message` uses it to render `(set by environment variable 'VARNAME')` between the param hint and the error text when it's set.

**`src/click/core.py`** — Two additions:

- `Parameter.get_active_envvar(ctx)` — walks the same `envvar` list as `resolve_envvar_value` but returns the *name* of whichever variable is currently set, rather than its value.
- `Option.get_active_envvar(ctx)` — delegates to the parent and falls back to the `auto_envvar_prefix` path, matching `Option.resolve_envvar_value`.

In `handle_parse_result`, the inner try/except is split so `BadParameter` is caught first: when `source is ParameterSource.ENVIRONMENT` and `e.env_var` isn't already set, it calls `get_active_envvar` and stamps the result onto the exception before re-raising.

**`tests/test_options.py`** — Four new tests cover the main cases (named envvar, multiple envvars, auto-prefix, command-line-not-affected). One existing test (`test_boolean_envvar_bad_values`) is updated to expect the new message format.
